description: This is a CMake script defining a custom function 'CreateLink' to create symbolic links during build configuration. The function parses arguments, checks CMake version, creates necessary directories, and then creates a symlink from target to link path, with a warning if CMake version is below 3.14.

methods.name: CreateLink
methods.description: Defines a function to create a symbolic link from a target path to a link path, handling different CMake versions and directory creation.
